purpose: Source-bound object facts and explicitly editorial contextual labels, kept separate from response data and visual attribute judgements.

evidenceKinds.primary-api-metadata: Exact fields from the institution's object API.
evidenceKinds.primary-institutional-record: Specific fields or claims verified in an official object page, catalogue or collection description.
evidenceKinds.existing-source-import: An explicit value already retained in the source-linked catalogue import; not independently reverified in this pass.
evidenceKinds.catalogue-editorial-classification: The previous catalogue's mixed historical grouping.
evidenceKinds.assistant-contextual-classification: An individually reviewed contextual refinement with a rationale, not an institution-endorsed or scientific label.
evidenceKinds.existing-catalogue-date-normalization: The previous finite editorial interval, not a new historical fact.
evidenceKinds.normalization-of-reported-medium: A modest derived filter based on explicit medium words.

limits: Unknown remains unknown. A missing fact never becomes a default based on artist or movement.
Culture, artist origin, birthplace, creation location, depicted location and holding institution are different concepts.
Movements, schools, regional traditions, object formats and visible treatments can overlap; their label kinds remain explicit.
Date intervals are catalogue conventions, not measured probabilities. Open-ended source wording remains visible.
The layer interprets current source records and does not mutate historical questions, answers, catalogue snapshots or numeric descriptors.
